summary: Contestants demonstrate foundational knowledge of information technology, including hardware, software, operating systems, networking, security, and technology applications. The event is an objective test with a time limit of sixty minutes. Any secondary or postsecondary student may enter, and reference materials or AI use are not allowed.
time_limits: no more than sixty (60) minutes testing time
what_to_bring: (Optional) Cordless calculator: Electronic devices will be monitored according to ACT standards. See NLC Calculator Guidelines.
competencies: Demonstrate foundational understanding of core IT concepts, including hardware, software, operating systems, and networking, and apply practical skills to configure, manage, and troubleshoot these components for secure and efficient operations
Explain the evolution of programming languages and apply this knowledge to evaluate language paradigms, features, and appropriate use cases when selecting technologies for various projects
Demonstrate understanding of cybersecurity principles, including risk management, access control, authentication, threat awareness, and best practices for protecting information systems
Demonstrate understanding of legal, ethical, and policy considerations in IT environments, including data privacy, intellectual property, compliance standards, and responsible technology use
Demonstrate foundational knowledge of database concepts, including relational structures, SQL basics, data integrity, storage practices, and the role of data management in organizational operations

Demonstrate understanding of operating system concepts such as file systems, process management, user permissions, configuration tools, and system utilities as they relate to supporting business technology environments

Demonstrate foundational knowledge of emerging and modern IT technologies —including cloud computing, virtualization, IoT, automation, and AI-related concepts —and evaluate their impact on organizational efficiency and technology strategy
judging_notes: AI Policy Level 1 No AI Allowed
Reference materials are not allowed. Contestants who violate this rule will be disqualified.
Contestants who violate calculator rule will be disqualified.
eligibility_notes: Any secondary or postsecondary division contestant may enter this objective event.
